hook.text: A sparse solo record from Molina, released alongside a more conventional album with Magnolia Electric Co.

sentences.text: In 2005 Magnolia Electric Co. put out a live album, a studio album and an EP.
The next year Molina released two more records.
Let Me Go, Let Me Go, Let Me Go is the sparse solo record of the pair.
Fading Trails, made with Magnolia Electric Co., is the more conventional of the two.
